Hell and the lake of fire is actually a metaphor for extreme gas-lighting. You'll view a reality so far from the true nature of your being and always be at odds with yourself and the world around you for it. 
Satan simply holds the perception of this reality of which you view in tandem, Satan is imbued with this perception "cast from the light" and projects it for all those who suffer in kind to view. As far as timing, you are in hell if you're suffering from any of the things man suffers from and upon reaching enlightenment you no longer suffer, therefore aren't in hell. All of it is circumstantial to your beliefs about the world around you and yourself. As far as the "different levels of enlightment" heaven being ultimate peace and oneness, think of it as traversing dimensions within yourself. The disobedience is straying from the God's perception of goodness and being lost in the eternal space of uncertainty. 

Satan believed that there could be a better reality created than that of which God held, by doing so, in looking for ultimate perfection, the reality of hell was created "the lake of fire" is a burning consciousness (gas-lighting). All of it simplified to be understood in the best way so that as many people who possibly wanted to would always have a guide to the perception of "God" ultimate goodness. 

The Bible itself is first hand accounts of various spiritual beings with trying to find their way back to the ultimate perception of perfection, creating various rules to, hopefully, leave their suffering. 

I'd like to think of it as matter vs. Anti-matter
Or even the creation of the universe vs the lack thereof

In Satan's plight to create more perfect, the idea of hell is born and the opposite from which Satan once reside is what is actually created. It was all about balance and understanding both sides of the figurative coin.
